title: Permit To Work (Ptw) Risk Assessment
description: Free Permit To Work (Ptw) Risk Assessment template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers permit to work system information, permit to work risk assessment, permit classification and requirements.

Permit Classification And Requirements

PERMIT TYPES:

☐ HOT WORK PERMIT - Work involving ignition sources (welding, grinding, cutting, spark-producing tools) Additional Requirements: Fire watch, gas testing, fire extinguisher, cover drains/flanges
☐ COLD WORK PERMIT - Work not involving ignition sources (mechanical, electrical, general maintenance) Additional Requirements: Area assessment, isolation as required, proper tools
☐ CONFINED SPACE ENTRY PERMIT - Entry into confined spaces (tanks, vessels, pits, excavations) Additional Requirements: Gas testing, ventilation, attendant, rescue plan, harness/lifeline
☐ ELECTRICAL PERMIT / LOTO - Work on electrical systems Additional Requirements: Isolation, LOTO, testing for dead, qualified electrician
☐ EXCAVATION / GROUND DISTURBANCE PERMIT - Digging, trenching, ground penetration Additional Requirements: Utility locate, shoring, barricading, slope protection
☐ RADIOACTIVE SOURCE / X-RAY PERMIT - NDT, logging, radiography Additional Requirements: RSO authorization, exclusion zone, dosimetry, signage
☐ HEAVY LIFT PERMIT - Critical or heavy lifts (>80% capacity, complex lifts) Additional Requirements: Lift plan, engineered lift, crane certification, banksman

Stop Work Authority

I understand that I have the authority and responsibility to Stop Work if:

☐ Conditions change from the permit

☐ I discover an uncontrolled hazard

☐ I am unsure about the safety of the task

☐ Gas test fails or alarms activate

☐ Weather conditions exceed safe limits

☐ Someone is at risk of injury

STOP WORK PROCEDURE:

1. Immediately stop the task

2. Make the area safe

3. Notify supervisor and PTW Coordinator

4. Do not resume until authorized
